replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
Hello,

You were banned a few days before the new rule regarding suicide encourage was introduced. Due to this, your temp ban will stay in place as Junr said above. Everyone who was temp banned before the new rule was active will continue to stay banned until their ban time is over. It's fair for everyone.

Regards,
Fouled
